MIT 3.071 Amorphous Materials, Spring 2025
Instructor: Juejun Hu
The lecture covers phase-change materials, specifically Ge-Sb-Te alloys, used in data storage applications, including their structure, properties, and performance metrics, as well as their applications in optics and non-volatile memory.
